| Q                   | A
| --------------------| ---------------
| PHPUnit version     | 9.0.0
| PHP version         | 7.4.5
| Installation Method | Composer 

#### Summary

<!-- Provide a summary describing the problem you are experiencing. -->

phpunit dies silently, without any output. After modifying phpunit.xml I am able to determine the failing place:

```C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp>vendor\bin\phpunit -c C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\phpunit.xml -v --debug tests\InvoiceRulesTest.php

Warning: require_once(C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\tests/../vendor/autoload.php): failed to open stream: No such file or directory in C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\tests\bootstrap.php on line 17

Call Stack:
    0.0002     351520   1. {main}() C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\phpunit:0
    0.0046     366752   2. PHPUnit\TextUI\Command::main() C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\phpunit:61
    0.0046     366864   3. PHPUnit\TextUI\Command->run() C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\src\TextUI\Command.php:160
    0.0046     366864   4. PHPUnit\TextUI\Command->handleArguments() C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\src\TextUI\Command.php:168
    0.0098     468240   5. PHPUnit\TextUI\Command->handleBootstrap() C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\src\TextUI\Command.php:853
    0.0099     468240   6. PHPUnit\Util\FileLoader::checkAndLoad() C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\src\TextUI\Command.php:1041
    0.0100     468544   7. PHPUnit\Util\FileLoader::load() C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\src\Util\FileLoader.php:44
    0.0100     469176   8. include_once('C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\tests\bootstrap.php') C:\Users\kymj\eclipse-workspace\testphp\vendor\phpunit\phpunit\src\Util\FileLoader.php:56

```

`testphp` -- is the name of the project.

File bootstrap.php comes from phpunit installation and contains `require_once __DIR__ . '/../vendor/autoload.php';`


#### Current behavior

<!-- What is the current (buggy) behavior? -->

PHPUnit doesn't work

#### How to reproduce

<!-- Provide steps to reproduce the bug. -->

I don't know, I haven't found any bug report like mine. probably there's something specific to my environment.

#### Expected behavior

<!-- What was the expected (correct) behavior? -->

PHPUnit does tests.

The whole test is:

tests\InvoiceRulesTest.php

```php
<?php
declare(strict_types = 1);
require_once __DIR__ . '../InvoiceRuleParser.php';

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class InvoiceRulesTest extends TestCase
{

    public function testNumericAdd(): void
    {
        $irp = new InvoiceRuleParser("1+2");
        $nval = $irp->match_nexpr();
        $this->assertIsArray($nval);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey($nval, [
            'val' => 3
        ]);
    }
}```
